name: Ruins of Isildien
summary: In southwestern Feralas, Gordunni ogres hold the overgrown Ruins of Isildien. The ancient night elven city fell during the Great Sundering ten thousand years ago.

sections.title: A Fallen City of the Kaldorei
sections.body:
Isildien once rose as a grand night elven settlement, before the world shattered. Marble arches and terraces showed the reach of kaldorei civilization and their devotion. Then the Well of Eternity imploded and tore the continents apart, leaving the city in ruins. Jungle growth covered its stones over the millennia.

A colossal dome crowns the upper terrace. It recalls Darnassus's Temple of the Moon and suggests Isildien held an important sanctuary dedicated to Elune.

sections.title: The Gordunni Stronghold
sections.body: The Gordunni ogres have made Isildien's terraces and outcroppings one of their chief settlements in Feralas. They brace the crumbling walkways with bonfires, barricades, and war banners, defiling the ancient plazas. The ogres fiercely defend their stolen home from outsiders who venture too near the southern hills.

faq.answer: Isildien was a major night elven city built before the Great Sundering, ten thousand years ago. The cataclysm left its stone plazas, terraces, and temples in ruins.

faq.q: Who controls the Ruins of Isildien now?
faq.answer: The Gordunni ogres have seized and fortified the ruins. They use the broken marble halls and natural vantage points as a stronghold in southern Feralas.

faq.q: What is the large circular pavilion at the top of the stairs?
faq.answer: The circular pavilion recalls the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. It suggests the upper dais once held a sanctuary dedicated to Elune.

faq.q: Is there anything hidden inside the ruins?
faq.answer: A cave lies in the eastern cliffs along the ruins. The ogres use it alongside the scattered stone terraces across the northern and southern grounds.

angles.text: Walking through Isildien recalls the height of your pre-Sundering empire, now ruined and desecrated by Gordunni ogres.
The great rotunda at the summit echoes Elune's high sanctuaries. Prayers to the White Lady were offered there ten thousand years ago.
